title: Universal Semantic Logger Schema
description: Framework-agnostic semantic logging schema. Context types and their schemas are defined by applications, not by this logging framework

log.description: Root-scope records in record order: intervals (each carrying its own log and matching close) and points. A root record may also be an orphan close (a close whose open is not in this document, or a duplicate close of an open already closed), kept in place with its openId. An empty array is a valid empty log.

types.description: Document-level type-to-schema index (compact form). When present, a record without its own schemaUrl resolves its schema through types[type]. A record's own schemaUrl, when present, must agree with this map.

links.description: Web Links for semantic relationships - extends JSON Schema with hypermedia concepts for AI understanding. While not part of JSON Schema specification, these links provide semantic context and relationships between log records, following RFC 8288 Web Linking principles. Enables AI to understand contextual relationships, dependencies, and semantic connections that pure data structure cannot express

rel.description: Link relationship type following RFC 8288 Web Linking

title.description: Human-readable title for the link relationship

type.description: Media type hint for the linked resource

examples.title: External API failure that triggered this error

rootRecord.description: One root-scope record: either a record (interval or point, discriminated structurally by the presence of `log`/`close`) or an orphan close (a close carrying `openId` because no open in this document owns it).

record.description: A record in log order. With `close` present it is a completed interval; with `log` (empty or not) and no `close` it is an interrupted interval; with neither `log` nor `close` it is a point. Never carries `openId` (that is reserved for root-level orphan closes) and never carries `kind` (structure discriminates, not a tag).

type.description: Application-defined context type (e.g., http_request, database_query, business_logic)

context.description: Application-specific context data conforming to the referenced schema

log.description: Records recorded while this interval was open, in record order. Present whenever the interval is unclosed (even if empty); omitted once closed if it has no children.

close.description: The close that ended this interval. Omitted when the interval is still open (interrupted) or when this record is a point.

profile.description: Observed profiling data attributed to this record. Present only when an attached profiler captured external Xdebug or XHProf output for it.

close.description: The close observation nested on its matching interval.

type.description: Application-defined context type (e.g., http_response, database_result, business_complete)

context.description: Application-specific context data conforming to the referenced schema

profile.description: Observed profiling data attributed to this specific operation. Present only when an attached profiler captured external Xdebug or XHProf output for this close.

orphanClose.description: A root-level close whose open is not in this document, or a duplicate close of an open that was already closed. Kept inline in the root `log` at the position it was encountered, carrying `openId` to name the open it attempted to close.

type.description: Application-defined context type (e.g., http_response, database_result, business_complete)

context.description: Application-specific context data conforming to the referenced schema

profile.description: Observed profiling data attributed to this specific operation. Present only when an attached profiler captured external Xdebug or XHProf output for this close.

operationId.description: Unique operation identifier following semantic naming convention: {type}_{sequence_number}

openIdReference.description: The id of the open an orphan close attempted to close.

contextType.description: Application-defined context type identifier. Applications define their own context types through individual schema files

operationProfile.description: Observed profiling data for a single operation (open/close pair). The profile object is emitted only when external profiler output was captured.

wallTime.description: Wall time for this operation in seconds under the instrumentation mode that produced this profile

xdebugTrace.description: Per-segment Xdebug trace file references captured while this operation was active. Omitted when no Xdebug trace output was captured.

path.description: Path to the Xdebug trace file on disk for this segment (a .gz suffix indicates a gzip-compressed trace)

xhprofProfile.description: Per-segment XHProf snapshot file references captured while this operation was active. Omitted when no XHProf output was captured.

path.description: Path to the XHProf snapshot file on disk for this segment

oneOf.description: Relative path to local schema file

schemaUrl.description: Context schema reference for AI-human understanding alignment. While humans naturally understand what this context represents, AI needs explicit schema guidance to achieve the same level of comprehension about data structure, constraints, and business meaning. Supports both absolute URLs and relative file paths.
schemaUrl.$comment: Bridge: Humans intuitively understand context meaning; AI uses this schema reference to gain equivalent understanding.
